text.en: Its words were printed in 1901 in New Jubilee Songs as Sung by the Fisk Jubilee Singers. Its arrangement there set the melody and harmony many later versions built on.
text.es: Su letra se imprimió en 1901 en New Jubilee Songs as Sung by the Fisk Jubilee Singers. El arreglo de ese libro fijó la melodía y la armonía en que se basaron muchas versiones posteriores.

text.en: The composer Harry T. Burleigh made it an art song for voice and piano. He reshaped the melody in the verses and lifted the tune an octave at the end for a stronger climax.
text.es: El compositor Harry T. Burleigh la convirtió en canción artística para voz y piano. Rehízo la melodía de las estrofas y la subió una octava al final para un clímax más fuerte.

text.en: Alvin Ailey's dance Revelations, first performed in 1960, uses it in the section Take Me to the Water. His company calls Revelations the most widely seen modern dance work in the world.
